content:
Alyssa: Hey team — need to schedule a 30-45m readout for the inference perf benchmarks. Goal: review latency/cost dashboards, compare model variants, agree on quantization rollout guardrails and next steps. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00-10:45 PT, Tue 15:00-15:45 PT, Wed 09:00-09:45 PT. Who can make it? Please include folks who ran the runs (Mike, Priya) and infra/product: Samir, Jen.

Mike: Tue 10 works for me. Can we add an agenda item for 'regression signal thresholds' — want to decide p95 targets + alerting.

Priya: Tue 15 is better for me. Also request adding 'request distribution / cold starts' and the exact model seeds used for the reported runs. I uploaded run ids to the doc: run-20260301-a, run-20260302-b.

Alyssa: OK — quick poll: react with :thumbsup: for Tue 10, :raised_hands: for Tue 15, :eyes: for Wed 09. I'll lock by tomorrow 12:00 PT and send calendar invite.

Samir: Add 'cost per 1k tokens by quant profile' and 'fallback behavior under high load'. Also suggest inviting eng-sre for capacity/fallback discussion.

bench-bot: Automated summary: latest bench run run-20260302-b — p50=21ms, p95=120ms, avg cost=0.012/token. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/bench/20260302-b. Logs: s3://redwood-bench/logs/run-20260302-b.tar.gz

Alyssa: Thanks. Linking PRs for pre-read: #4870 (dynamic batching changes), #4892 (kv-cache cold-start fix). Please add short notes or blockers in-thread. Reviewers: @Mike, @Priya.

Mike: I pushed a small tweak to #4870 to adjust the batching window based on seq length histogram. Quick test included in dashboard — throughput up ~6% for long-tail sequences.

Priya: On quantization experiments: we need a quality guardrail. Proposal: eval set 'prod-smoke-v2' with min acceptance 0.98 (relative). I'll add the eval outputs to the meeting doc and flag any samples that regressed.

Jen: I can make Tue 10. I will prepare an infra capacity plan and the impact matrix for fallback to smaller model variants.

Alyssa: Sounds good. If nobody objects I'll lock Tue 10 PT and send the invite with agenda + links by EOD. Bring <=2 slides per owner: benchmarking owner (Priya), runtime changes (Mike), infra/fallback (Jen), product ask (Samir).

Samir: No blockers from product. I'll prepare cost/sla tradeoffs + recommended rollout timeline (canary -> staged -> full).

Alyssa: Great — locking Tue 10 PT. Meeting doc (w/ pre-reads): https://docs.redwood.ai/syncs/bench-readout-2026-03-10. If you have short pre-reads, paste below or attach to the doc.

Mike: I'll drop perf traces + a small synthetic load script in the doc. Command to reproduce locally: ```./bench_client --model opt-2.7b --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --run-id run-20260302-b```

Priya: I'll add the quantization eval table and a short checklist for post-rollout quality checks.

Alyssa: Thanks everyone. Locking and sending invite now. Ping me if you need a different slot.
